name: Fresh Install Contamination Audit
description: Scan repo files for operator-specific contamination (hardcoded project IDs, emails, Drive IDs, org names) that would break a fresh fork. Used as the REPO improvement gate.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: Before landing any REPO-tier improvement via a PR to main. The repo-improvement skill calls this scan as a mandatory gate. Also usable standalone for periodic contamination audits.
